issue.title: Greenfield foundation: init_tiki_project + git-write layer + .gitignore + guarded state seed

successCriteria.description: init_tiki_project on a blank folder yields a valid .tiki/ (state.json {schemaVersion:1,activeWork:{}}, .framework-version, .claude/commands/tiki/*, .claude/tiki/scripts/*, reconciler hook) and is idempotent — re-running never clobbers an existing state.json.
A git_init path initializes a repo and writes the policy .gitignore, with every git spawn routed through hidden_command.
The command-hygiene source-scan guard still passes (no raw Command::new outside hidden_command).
Tests cover the idempotency guard (existing state.json preserved, no backup created) and the blank-folder happy path.

phases.title: Git-write layer in github/git.rs
phases.content: Add the net-new git-write layer to apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/github/git.rs (today read-only: only get_current_branch/list_git_branches). Add four functions, each built via super::hidden_command("git") (NEVER raw Command::new — the source-scan guard at github/mod.rs:202-258 fails the build otherwise) with .current_dir(project_path) set UNCONDITIONALLY: (1) git_init(project_path) running `git init -b main` (dev=git 2.43 / CI>=2.40 support -b; an optional one-line `git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main` catch on -b failure is fine, but do NOT build an ancient-git <2.28 fallback phase/fixture); (2) git_add_remote(project_path, name, url); (3) git_commit_all(project_path, message) doing `git add -A` then `git commit -m <message>` — callers treat failure as non-fatal; (4) git_remote_get(project_path) -> Result<Option<String>, String> running `git remote get-url origin`, mapping the 'no such remote' non-zero exit to Ok(None) and real failures to Err. Mirror the existing error mapping (git.rs:14-28: ErrorKind::NotFound -> 'Git is not installed'; non-zero -> stderr-mapped). Register the public commands in lib.rs's generate_handler! list (append-only).
verification: cargo build (project references, strict) is clean
cargo test --lib passes including new git tests: git_init creates .git/; git_add_remote + git_remote_get round-trips the origin URL; git_remote_get returns Ok(None) with no remote
the command-hygiene source-scan guard test (github/mod.rs:202) stays green
phases.summary: git-write layer (git_init -b main, git_add_remote, git_commit_all, git_remote_get) via hidden_command + registered in lib.rs; +3 tests, cargo test --lib 82 pass, clippy clean, hygiene guard green

phases.title: Guarded state seed + .gitignore writer in fs_utils.rs
verification: cargo test --lib passes including: seed writes the canonical literal when state.json is missing
seed PRESERVES an existing state.json byte-identical AND creates NO backup file (proves the destructive write_fresh_state path was not taken — the idempotency guard)
write_starter_gitignore skips when .gitignore present and writes the policy content when absent (asserts it ignores journal.ndjson and does NOT ignore state.json)
cargo build clean; cargo clippy --all-targets --deny warnings clean
phases.summary: seed_state_if_absent (only-if-absent, exact canonical literal, no destructive path) + write_starter_gitignore (commit-state.json policy) in fs_utils.rs; +4 tests incl. idempotency guard (no backup created); cargo test --lib 86 pass; expected dead_code on the 2 helpers resolves in phase 3

phases.title: install_framework_inner refactor + init_tiki_project command + registration
phases.content: Refactor install_framework (commands.rs:715-765) by extracting its body into a private install_framework_inner(project: &Path, version: &str) -> Result<(), String> so init can call it without an AppHandle round-trip; keep the existing #[tauri::command] install_framework as a thin wrapper over it. Add #[tauri::command] init_tiki_project(app: AppHandle, project_path: String, init_git: Option<bool>) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> returning a warnings list (NOT the 5-boolean InitReport — no consumer renders it). Steps in order: (1) validate project_path exists (mirror install_framework:717); (2) install_framework_inner(&project, &app.package_info().version.to_string()); (3) fs_utils::seed_state_if_absent(&project.join(".tiki")); (4) fs_utils::write_starter_gitignore(&project); (5) if init_git (default true) and not already a repo, BEST-EFFORT github::git_init(&project) then git_commit_all(&project, "chore: initialize Tiki project") — on failure (e.g. missing git user.name/user.email) push a human-readable string into the warnings Vec and CONTINUE; never abort init. Do NOT call switch_project — the caller (#285) sequences it after, because switch_project (commands.rs:225) hard-requires .tiki to already exist. Register init_tiki_project in lib.rs. NOTE: check_greenfield_readiness is NOT part of this issue (it lives in #284).
verification: cargo build (project references, strict) is clean
cargo test --lib passes including init_tiki_project_blank_folder_happy_path (asserts .tiki/state.json, .framework-version, at least one command + one script, reconciler hook in .claude/settings.json)
init_tiki_project_is_idempotent: an activeWork entry written between two init runs survives the second run (no clobber)
init_tiki_project is registered in lib.rs and callable; cargo clippy --all-targets --deny warnings clean
phases.summary: install_framework_inner refactor (behavior preserved) + init_tiki_project(app, projectPath, initGit) -> Vec<String> warnings: composes inner install + guarded seed + gitignore + best-effort git_init/commit (non-fatal), no switch_project; registered in lib.rs; +2 tests (happy path, idempotency); cargo test --lib 88 pass; clippy --all-targets --deny warnings CLEAN
